name: fullstack-chat-repo
description: Agent with Auth and Payments application with LangGraph agents and Next.js UI

scripts.dev:self-contained: pnpm --filter web setup:self-contained && concurrently -k -n web,agents -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev:self-contained" "pnpm --filter agents dev:self-contained"
scripts.setup:db: echo '🗄️  Setting up Supabase database schema...' && echo '' && echo '⚡ Quick setup (requires .env files configured):' && echo 'npx supabase db execute --file supabase-schema.sql --project-ref YOUR_PROJECT_REF' && echo '' && echo '📋 Manual setup (recommended):' && echo '1. Open Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor' && echo '2. Copy and paste contents of supabase-schema.sql' && echo '3. Click Run' && echo '' && echo '💡 Find your project ref in your Supabase URL: https://YOUR_PROJECT_REF.supabase.co'
scripts.verify:self-contained: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter agents build
